name: Demeter
summary: Goddess of the harvest, agriculture, and fertility of the earth. Mother of Persephone; her grief over her daughter's abduction by Hades is the mythic explanation for the changing seasons.
domain_role: Agriculture, grain, the harvest, the fertility of the earth
origin_story: A daughter of Cronus and Rhea, Demeter presided over the earth's fertility. Her defining myth centers on her daughter Persephone: when Hades abducted Persephone to be his queen in the Underworld, Demeter's grief caused the earth to grow barren. A compromise was reached in which Persephone spent part of the year in the Underworld and part with her mother, explaining the cycle of the seasons.
achievements: Central figure of the Eleusinian Mysteries, one of the most important religious institutions in the Greek world
Regarded as the goddess responsible for teaching humanity agriculture
Her myth of Persephone's abduction and return became the foundational story explaining the seasons

signature_quote.text: I am Demeter, giver of grain and seasons.
signature_quote.note: The line connects Demeter's identity directly to grain, agriculture, and the seasonal cycle on which human life depends.
